_comment: Add 'openrouterjsonreformat' to the CONNECTORS.values array, and add this section inside the CONNECTOR object alongside openrouterjson, openrouter, etc.

url.description:
Format proxy URL. Should be: http://127.0.0.1:38800/v1/chat/completions?upstream=YOUR_UPSTREAM_URL
For OpenRouter: ?upstream=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions
For Claude proxy: ?upstream=http://127.0.0.1:38700/v1/chat/completions

model.description: LLM model to use. Passed through to the upstream API.

reasoning_model.description: Select True if this is a reasoning model and you want to remove CoT (text between 'think' tags).

x_input_format.description:
Input format — how past NPC dialogue appears in context history.
clean_text: (Recommended) Rewrites JSON assistant messages into natural text like Lydia: I'll follow you. [Follow > Player]. Improves response quality by removing JSON noise from context.
vanilla: Pass through CHIM's default JSON-formatted assistant messages unchanged.

x_input_include_name.description: Include NPC name prefix in rewritten dialogue: Lydia: message. Always recommended.

x_input_include_mood.description: Include mood in rewritten dialogue: Lydia (concerned): message. Can add context but also noise.

x_input_include_action.description: Include non-Talk actions in rewritten dialogue: message [Follow > Player]. Helps the model understand action history.

x_input_include_listener.description: Include listener in rewritten dialogue: (to Player) message. Useful for multi-NPC conversations.

x_output_format.description:
Output format — what format the LLM responds in.
vanilla: Standard CHIM JSON format. The proxy passes the response through unchanged.
simple: Lightweight (mood)(listener)(action)(target) dialogue format. The proxy converts the response back to JSON for CHIM. Uses fewer tokens and lets the model focus on dialogue quality.

x_output_include_mood.description: Include (mood) field in simple output format. Used for NPC animations.

x_output_include_action.description: Include (action) field in simple output format. Required for NPC actions like Follow, Attack, etc.

x_output_include_target.description: Include (target) field in simple output format. Specifies who/what the action targets.

x_output_include_listener.description: Include (listener) field in simple output format. Specifies who the NPC is speaking to.

x_upstream_type.description:
What's downstream of the format proxy.
direct: Format proxy connects directly to OpenRouter/OpenAI/etc. Proxy handles cache marker placement.
claude_proxy: Format proxy connects to the Claude subscription proxy. Cache markers are deferred to the Claude proxy.

x_proxy_port.description: Port the format proxy listens on. Default: 38800. Change if the default conflicts with another service.

fallback_models.description: List of fallback models to use when the main model returns an error. Comma-separated list.

PROVIDER.description: Leave blank unless you want to manually select providers from OpenRouter. Comma-separated case sensitive list.

providers_to_ignore.description: Providers to ignore. Comma-separated case sensitive list.

provider_quantizations.description: Quantization levels to filter by. Comma-separated case sensitive list.

provider_max_price_input.description: Use only providers that have lower input price per million tokens. Zero to disable.

provider_max_price_output.description: Use only providers that have lower output price per million tokens. Zero to disable.

ENFORCE_JSON.description: Enforce JSON output format. Only used when Output Format is 'vanilla'. The proxy disables this automatically when Output Format is 'simple'.

PREFILL_JSON.description: Prefill JSON response for dumber LLMs. Only used when Output Format is 'vanilla'.

API_KEY.description: API key for the upstream service (OpenRouter, etc.)

json_schema.description: Enable structured output schema. Only used when Output Format is 'vanilla'.
